seams.description: The Go supervise component is a heartbeat skeleton; the real census still runs via process-census.py until the census port (Phase 1).
arm-supervision.sh's announce/require-holder/classify remain worktree-lease.py; the Go owner touches no lease by design (D-1/REG-7).
adopt.sh decides source cleanliness, payload membership, collisions, config transform; its decision core ports in Phase 4 as `metasystem adopt`.
